checks: Unique IDs and complete outliner references
Valid texture indices and bounded UV coordinates
Embedded textures equal the separately supplied PNG files
Animation group targets and keyframe times
Door surfaces clear main walls at six sampled angles
Front slit, open doorway and headroom ray samples are clear
Bottom of model is at Y=0
limitations: Structural file validation and Blender renders; no Blockbench UI or Minecraft test performed.
Geometric checks use sampled poses and rays; they are not exhaustive collision validation.
